_comment: Optional GameChanger deep links rendered as chat tiles on the Scheduler Portal. In the GC app: open the team, copy the web link to its Chat tab, and paste it as chat_url (must be an https:// URL). Tiles only render for entries with a chat_url set — while these are empty, the portal shows a single generic GameChanger tile instead.
